proposals.evidence: Qualified western members of Turner’s chewing/biting cāv- family (Gujarati cāvvũ and Marathi ċāvṇẽ chew/bite). The survey continuum preserves cāv beside vocalized cāu-/tsāu- and sāv-/sāu-, with local l/y-past endings. These are single verbs or an imperative/past pair of the same verb, not clauses with unanalysed auxiliaries.
